customer.title: {org} Remote Support
customer.subtitle: Please follow the steps below as guided by your agent.
customer.warning.title: Beware of phone scams
customer.warning.body: Only enter the code if you have verified the agent yourself. Banks and law enforcement never ask for remote control. If anyone asks for your account password, security card, or OTP, disconnect immediately and report it.
customer.step1.title: Install the remote support app
customer.step1.body: Install it for free from the Microsoft Store, which comes built into Windows.
customer.step1.fallback: If the button does not work, click here to open it on the web
customer.step1.download_note: If your company policy blocks the Store, you can download the executable directly.
customer.step2.title: Run the app
customer.step2.body: Once installed, use the button below to launch it. You can also find "RemoteHelp" in the Start menu.
customer.step3.title: Enter the 6-digit code
customer.step3.body: Enter the 6-digit number your agent gave you over the phone, then press [Connect].
customer.notice.title: Good to know
customer.notice.item1: While a session is active, a "Remote support in progress" indicator stays visible at the top right of your screen.
customer.notice.item2: You can press [End] on that indicator at any time to disconnect.
customer.notice.item3: The app leaves nothing behind on your computer once the session ends.
customer.download.unavailable.title: The program is being prepared
customer.download.unavailable.body: The {org} remote support program has not been published yet. Please contact your agent.
survey.title: Remote Support Satisfaction Survey
survey.already: You have already responded to this survey. Thank you.
home.meta.description: Business remote support that starts with a 6-digit code while you are on the phone with your customer.
home.hero.title1: While you are on the phone,
home.hero.title4: puts their screen in front of you
home.hero.body: Your customer runs the app and types the code. Your agent just opens a browser. No installation steps, no firewall rules, no remote software to manage.
home.hero.price: {price} KRW per year · {accounts} agent seats included
home.flow.title: How a session starts
home.flow.step1.title: The agent issues a code
home.flow.step1.body: One click in the console. Valid for 10 minutes, single use.
home.flow.step2.title: The customer enters it
home.flow.step2.body: They open your branded page, run the app, and type the code.
home.flow.step3.title: They allow, you connect
home.flow.step3.body: Nothing starts without their explicit consent.
home.flow.sample: Example of a code you read out to the customer
home.value.1.title: Nothing to install
home.value.1.body: Nothing is left on the customer's PC after the session. There is nothing at all to install for your agents.
home.value.2.title: Control from the browser
home.value.2.body: Agents view and control the customer screen directly in Chrome, Edge, or any modern browser.
home.value.3.title: Port 443 only
home.value.3.body: No extra ports to open in your customer's firewall. It uses the same path as ordinary web traffic.
home.value.4.title: Multiple languages
home.value.4.body: Korean, English, and Japanese are supported. Each organization picks its own interface language, so overseas customers are guided in their own language.
home.value.5.title: Time zone aware
home.value.5.body: Each organization sets its own time zone. Session history and statistics show local time, so working across regions stays unambiguous.
home.value.6.title: Never without consent
home.value.6.body: Every session requires the customer to enter a code and allow it. There is no unattended access.
home.how.title: How it works
home.how.subtitle: Three steps for your customer. That is all.
home.how.1.title: Open your page
home.how.1.body: Each organization gets its own address. Your agent reads it out to the customer.
home.how.2.title: Run the app
home.how.2.body: Install from the Microsoft Store or download the executable directly. No admin rights, no reboot.
home.how.3.title: Enter the code and allow
home.how.3.body: They type the 6-digit code and press Allow. Their screen appears on the agent's console.
home.features.title: Features
home.features.subtitle: Only what a support session actually needs.
home.features.1.title: Screen viewing and remote control
home.features.1.body: See the customer screen live and drive their mouse and keyboard. Only changed regions are sent, so it stays usable on slow links.
home.features.2.title: Web console for agents
home.features.2.body: Handle the queue, issue codes, and run the session from the browser with nothing installed.
home.features.3.title: Branded customer page
home.features.3.body: Each organization gets a guidance page carrying its own name and logo.
home.features.4.title: Clipboard transfer
home.features.4.body: Push long URLs or verification codes straight into the customer's clipboard.
home.features.5.title: Notes and history
home.features.5.body: Notes written during a session are stored with it and stay searchable afterwards.
home.features.6.title: Satisfaction survey
home.features.6.body: Collect a rating and comments when the session ends, and review them as statistics.
home.features.7.title: Quality control
home.features.7.body: Agents adjust image quality and frame rate to match the connection.
home.features.8.title: Multi-monitor and high resolution
home.features.8.body: Customer PCs with several monitors are shown as one full desktop.
home.features.9.title: Language and time zone
home.features.9.body: Each organization sets its interface language (Korean, English, Japanese) and time zone.
home.features.note: File transfer, session recording, and mobile device support are in preparation.
home.security.title: Security and customer protection
home.security.body: Remote support means touching someone else's PC. It is designed so that a session can never start unnoticed, never linger afterwards, and never be something the customer cannot stop.
home.security.phishing.title: Guarding against phone scams
home.security.phishing.body: A warning is always visible on the customer page and on the app's first screen, reminding customers that banks and law enforcement never ask for remote control.
home.security.1.title: Encrypted end to end
home.security.1.body: TLS from the customer PC through to the agent's browser. No segment travels in the clear.
home.security.2.title: Single-use codes and tokens
home.security.2.body: Connection codes expire after 10 minutes and cannot be reused. Agent connection tokens are single-use too.
home.security.3.title: Explicit consent
home.security.3.body: Nothing connects until the customer presses Allow. Unattended access is not offered.
home.security.4.title: Always visible, always stoppable
home.security.4.body: An indicator stays at the top right of the screen throughout, and the customer can end the session at any moment.
home.security.5.title: No residue
home.security.5.body: Temporary files are removed when the session ends. No resident program or service is left behind.
home.security.6.title: Audit trail
home.security.6.body: Connection time, the agent who handled it, and the reason it ended are all recorded for later review.
home.pricing.title: Pricing
home.pricing.subtitle: One simple annual price. No hidden costs.
home.pricing.note: Need more seats or different terms? Just ask.
home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.1.q: Does anything get installed on the customer's PC?
home.faq.1.a: The customer runs a single executable — there is no installation wizard. Temporary files are removed when the session ends and nothing is left behind. They can also install it as an app from the Microsoft Store.
home.faq.2.q: What do agents need to install?
home.faq.2.a: Nothing. They sign in from a browser and start working.
home.faq.3.q: Do we need to open firewall ports?
home.faq.3.a: No. Only port 443, the same as ordinary web traffic. The customer PC connects outbound, so nothing needs configuring on their side either.
home.faq.4.q: Can a session start without the customer's consent?
home.faq.4.a: No. Every session requires the customer to enter the code and press Allow. Features such as reconnecting automatically after a reboot are not provided.
home.faq.5.a: When running without administrator rights, Windows policy prevents control of UAC dialogs. In that case the agent guides the customer verbally through the prompt.
home.faq.6.a: Korean, English, and Japanese. Each organization sets its own interface language and time zone, so overseas customers are guided in their own language and local time.
home.faq.7.a: Customer PCs need Windows 10 or later. Agents can use any operating system with a modern browser. macOS and mobile support are in preparation.
home.faq.8.a: A single annual licence covers {accounts} agent seats. There are no extra charges based on session count or duration. Contact us if you need more seats.
home.faq.9.q: How long is session history kept?
home.faq.9.a: Connection times, the handling agent, notes, and satisfaction scores are all retained. The retention period is agreed when you onboard.
home.cta.title: Stop explaining over the phone. Just look at the screen.
home.cta.body: Apply, get approved by our operator, and start supporting customers right away.
footer.tagline: A B2B remote support service for companies supporting their own customers' Windows PCs.
footer.copyright: A remote session only ever starts with the customer's explicit consent.
